title: Audit bundle overlay parity flags prepared-caster formula supersets as mismatches
description: The generated D&D SRD audit bundle reports overlay-vs-pack parity mismatches for class:cleric, class:druid, class:paladin, and class:wizard data.spellPreparation. The actual pack data includes source-backed preparationFormula fields, while the parity report's expected overlay projection drops preparationFormula before comparing. This makes a successful migration to richer generated-pack facts appear as four mismatches in metadata.json and reports/overlay-vs-pack-parity.*. Update the audit-bundle parity projection or comparison so these source-backed formula supersets are treated as expected, and add/adjust coverage so future bundles report zero mismatches when generated pack facts intentionally extend the legacy overlay shape.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh npm run audit-bundle:dnd5e-srd reports overlayVsPackParity.mismatchedFacts as 0 for the current prepared-caster spellPreparation facts, without removing the preparationFormula fields from class records.
close_reason: Fixed spellPreparationFromOverlay to include preparationFormula; audit-bundle now reports 0 overlay mismatches
